title: Brazil CNPJ → Markdown DD card input
description: Paste Brazilian CNPJs (punctuation OK). Default provider: BrasilAPI (keyless public JSON), falling back to CNPJ.ws / ReceitaWS public endpoints. Bring your own ReceitaWS or CNPJ.ws commercial key for production volume. Email and telephone are never output. Only successful cards are charged.

cnpjs.title: CNPJs
cnpjs.description: One CNPJ per line, e.g. 33.000.167/0001-01 or 33000167000101. Punctuation and spaces are stripped, numbers shorter than 14 digits are left-padded with zeros, check digits are validated (invalid rows are free). Duplicates dropped.

datasetId.title: Dataset ID (CNPJ list)
datasetId.description: Optional. Read CNPJs from another run's dataset (field from 'CNPJ field', else cnpj / CNPJ / taxId / documento).

keyValueStoreId.title: Key-value store ID (CNPJ list)
keyValueStoreId.description: Optional. Read CNPJs from a key-value record: JSON array, {"cnpjs": [...]}, or plain text with one CNPJ per line.

keyValueRecordKey.title: Key-value record key
keyValueRecordKey.description: Record key inside the key-value store.

cnpjField.title: CNPJ field (dataset / JSON objects)
cnpjField.description: Optional. Name of the field holding the CNPJ in dataset items or JSON objects.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: auto = BrasilAPI first, then (with apiKey) your keyed provider, then the remaining keyless public endpoint. brasilapi / cnpjws / receitaws = that provider only (cnpjws and receitaws use your apiKey when given, else their rate-limited public endpoints).

apiKey.title: Provider API key (optional)
apiKey.description: Optional ReceitaWS token (sent as Authorization: Bearer) or CNPJ.ws commercial token (sent as x_api_token to comercial.cnpj.ws). Not needed for BrasilAPI. Stored encrypted, never logged or output. Placeholders like YOUR_KEY are ignored.

keyProvider.title: Key belongs to (auto mode)
keyProvider.description: Which provider your apiKey is for when provider=auto.

stopOnAuthError.title: Stop using key after auth error
stopOnAuthError.description: After the keyed provider returns 401/403 once, skip it for the remaining CNPJs (auto mode keeps using keyless providers). Failed rows are free.

includeQsa.title: Include QSA (partners / administrators)
includeQsa.description: Add a QSA summary: names, roles and entry date only. No CPF fragments, ages or contact details.

includeRagChunks.title: Write RAG chunks (CHUNKS.jsonl)
includeRagChunks.description: Write one self-describing chunk per card section to the key-value store record CHUNKS.jsonl.

maxItems.title: Max CNPJs
maxItems.description: Stop after this many unique valid CNPJs (0 = no limit).

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel lookups. Public endpoints are rate-limited; 2 is a safe default.

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: Retries per provider for HTTP 429 (honours Retry-After, capped at 30 s), 5xx, timeouts and network errors. 400/401/403/404 are not retried.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Timeout for each provider HTTP call.
